channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLhealthAndWellness, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Health coaching may improve blood pressure control in postpartum women
item.description: A health coaching program combined with self-measured blood pressure monitoring was linked to significant improvements in blood pressure control among postpartum women.

item.title: Potential language-specific brain network identified
item.description: Researchers have identified a brain network for language that is active even when a person is not speaking, according to a study in Nature Communications.

item.title: Aprepitant Eases Cannabinoid Hyperemesis Syndrome in Teens
item.description: Adolescents hospitalized with cannabinoid hyperemesis syndrome had shorter stays and faster symptom relief when given aprepitant as an add-on therapy.

item.title: Poison center reports of liver injuries rise nearly 400% since 2000, with acetaminophen as a top driver
item.description: Calls to poison centers about liver injuries from medications, supplements, alcohol, and other substances increased nearly 400% between 2000 and 2020, with acetaminophen a leading cause.
